unet: TRAIN (proof passed its purpose): from-scratch, synthetic-only, 1.56 M params. Transfers to real sheets: exterior-wall recall 0.91-1.00; on the wall axis 61/63 real openings OPENING (47 at >= 0.8, 0 wrong) and 50/65 continuations (44 at >= 0.8, 0 wrong) - the first, face-placed run gave 23/63 (post-review A2/C1). Round-8: cyklamenach window 97 % opening; gozdzikowcach porch mouth 100 % background, pier 100 % wall (first pier box misplaced, C2), the 0.41 m LEAF_FACE gap ~94 % opening on its axis - the one gap whose upgrade completes gozdzikowcach in the oracle replay. Adds ~0 exterior wall over source-cv: its value is the OPENING / BACKGROUND reading at a gap. NOT a referee yet: over-reads open gaps (12 synthetic confident-wrong; false OPENING on dimension ink 18 %), real evidence small and one-sided. Basis for 005K-a.
segformer: DEFER: MiT-B0 (3.71 M; independent re-implementation, not clean-room — its structure follows the Apache-2.0 PVTv2 / HF code) at the same budget is slower (4.5 s vs 1.2 s per 864^2 frame in WASM, >= 928 vs >= 340 MiB), reads fewer real openings (0.58-0.81 vs 0.72-0.90) and misses the gozdzikowcach garage door (82 % background); fewer false walls inside exclusions (<= 0.8 % vs <= 3.6 %), no synthetic confident-wrong, and fewer false OPENING readings (post-review A, P2); its 20 face-placed REAL_DEV confident-wrong fall to 2 on the wall axis (post-review C1), so they are not a reason to defer it. The reasons are speed, memory and the missed garage door. Revisit if 005K's UNet cannot meet the false-OPENING gate.
routeCPilot: PILOT RESULT: NEGATIVE ON REAL. A 1.07 M-param image-level classifier trained only on synthetic question images learns the synthetic task (85 % on held-out seeds, 2.7 % confident-wrong at 0.80, 0 at >= 0.98) but does not transfer: REAL_DEV 49.7 % (below the 76 % majority floor), 34 % confident-wrong at 0.80, still 1.2 % at 0.999. Image-level questions need real-style data and/or a pixel-level observation underneath; feasible on device (70 ms per question in WASM).
overall: The commercially clean, transferable piece is a pixel-level wall/opening observation model trained from scratch on BuildPlan synthetic data (UNet-lite). Whole-image referees (generic small VLMs zero-shot, and a from-scratch synthetic classifier) do not transfer to real sheets at the confident-wrong bar.
